title: Side-Quest Adoption Rate
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session side_quests_offered=*
| stats sum(side_quests_offered) as offered, sum(side_quests_taken) as taken by campaign
| eval adoption_pct=round(100*taken/offered,1)
| sort - adoption_pct
description: Shows how often your players bite on optional hooks instead of staying on the main plot only.
value: Knowing which hooks actually land helps a GM prep the kinds of side content a table enjoys.
implementation: Log side-quest offers and accepts in `campaign:session` events; calculate the adoption percentage per campaign.
visualization: Table of campaigns with side-quest offer and take rates.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which optional adventures your group actually wants to chase instead of ignore.
